poc_details: Scope: Hosted API POC -> validate functional parity with existing provider + measure cost/latency at production-like load
Data: 12k product docs, 38k QA pairs, user search traces for peak windows
Targets: embedding QPS target 200, reranking latency p95 < 250ms, generation chat latency p95 < 350ms
Models: tested Redwood-curated open LLMs (quantized variants) and compatibility shim against prior provider's chat endpoint
Findings: embeddings throughput met target at lower cost (~18% savings) with batching; reranker had intermittent ranking regressions vs baseline for edge-case abbreviations
Prompt parity: ~88% pass on automated evals; failures concentrated on entity canonicalization and enumeration formatting
Regression strategy: add prompt anchors, extended context windows, and automated eval harness to catch distributional regressions before rollout
Operational: prefix/KV caching and auto-batching gave 22% token cost reduction in tests; Dedicated expected to stabilize tail latency under sustained load
requirements_summary: Must preserve current user-facing summary quality (no more than 0.5% drop on NIST-like eval set)
Data residency for EU customers (subset of traffic must stay in eu-west region)
SAML SSO for admin console, audit logs retained 1 year, KMS integration for customer keys
Predictable pricing for sustained QPS (looking for 12–24 month commit options)
Compatibility layer to minimize app changes — prefer path with small shim over full prompt rewrite
migration_plan: Phase 1 (Hosted POC): compatibility shim + adapter to accept existing API shapes; automated evaluation of 5k golden prompts
Phase 2 (Prompt parity): iterate prompts, add post-processing layer for canonicalization, maintain lightweight AB tests for quality
Phase 3 (Dedicated prep): capacity planning workshop, identify GPU pool sizing and burst policy, network/VPC setup
Phase 4 (Cutover): Canaries by customer region, regression monitoring dashboard, rollback to Hosted fallback if regressions exceed threshold
Success criteria: production parity on eval sets, p95 latency within SLA, approved DPA and infra checklist
